[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Isric''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial soldier]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He served aboard [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]]'s ship, and he achieved the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] by the year [[3643 BBY]]. During the [[Assault on the Esseles|assault]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] cruiser [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] to capture [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Vyn Asara]], Isric led the Imperial boarding party that was in actuality a distraction for [[Ironfist]]'s [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] troops. While Ironfist's forces were seizing the bridge, Isric and his troops were killed by a group of Republic defenders.
